title: Sub-quorum colorings: hypercube proof, structural results, and grid-strip certificates
description: Research artifact containing a Lean proof of the hypercube sub-quorum conjecture for every dimension n >= 2, a working manuscript, structural proofs including an exact grafting theorem and unbounded gaps on subcubic trees, and independently recomputed full-vector certificates for rectangular grid widths 8, 9, 10, and 11 at all positive lengths. Only the hypercube coloring-number theorem is Lean formalized. The artifact credits Sahbi's source conjectures and transfer method and Huang's signed-matrix construction.
